text.tspan: AI may reduce candidate counts while increasing characterization per molecule
From molecule throughput to data density: a potential driver of life science tools demand
Binding first; deeper tests for selected hits
Measure selected properties on shared molecules; fill the information gaps
Learn binding, expression, stability and functional relationships
